def _message(
    *,
    stage: str = "",
    control_id: str = "",
    content_kind: ContentKind = "model_reasoning",
    content_mode: ContentMode = "delta",
    text: str = "",
) -> ReasoningMessage:
    """Return an attributed canonical message carrying test defaults."""
    return ReasoningMessage(
        key=("", "m"),
        content_kind=content_kind,
        content_mode=content_mode,
        attributed=True,
        control_id=control_id,
        stage=stage,
        text=text,
    )


def test_display_text_strips_provider_markup_from_assembled_text() -> None:
    """Display sanitizing never rewrites the canonical received text."""
    raw = "<think>Compare profile evidence.</think>"
    message = _message(text=raw)

    assert (
        strip_reasoning_markup(raw),
        message.display_text,
        message.text,
    ) == ("Compare profile evidence.", "Compare profile evidence.", raw), (
        "the sanitizer drops provider markup while canonical state keeps it verbatim"
    )
